prompts:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original temporary portrait for a clearly labeled dental website demo, not a real clinic employee.
Scene/backdrop: clean seamless pale neutral silver-gray studio background (#eceeef), no objects.
Style: high-quality professional editorial studio photography, natural skin pores and subtle real-life facial texture, restrained neutral color, believable and approachable. No fashion glamour or plastic beauty retouch.
Composition: one adult person only, centered, straight-on camera at eye level, chest-up extending to just above waist, vertical 4:5 composition. Entire hair and top of head visible with generous 12% headroom; shoulders fully visible with space at both sides for responsive cropping. Head takes about 28% of image height, eyes around 30% from top. Torso approximately frontal, gaze into camera, relaxed natural small smile, arms resting out of frame.
Lighting: large soft studio key from upper left and subtle fill, delicate shadows, consistent exposure and pale background, 85mm portrait lens feel.
Wardrobe: immaculate simple light gray medical tunic with a modest collar and subtle woven fabric, no lab coat over it, no badges, logos, names or lettering.
Constraints: invent a new anonymous person, do not resemble any known person, no reference to real doctors. No text, watermark, stethoscope, instruments, medical props, hands near face, jewelry emphasis, busy setting. Full-color image with naturally warm skin against neutral silver background.
Subject: adult woman around 35, shoulder-length dark brown hair neatly tucked behind ears, brown eyes, softly angular face, warm calm natural smile.
